channel.title: The Morning Brief
channel.description: A private daily market brief: what moved overnight, why, and what to watch.
channel.itunes:author: Samuel Gibby
channel.itunes:summary: A private daily market brief: what moved overnight, why, and what to watch.

item.title: Bond Market Jitters Overshadow Nvidia Anticipation
item.description: Treasury's buyback push, a weak jobs report, and Nvidia earnings on deck — the debt story is running the show.

item.title: Iran Pressure, Walmart Slips, Yields Rebound
item.description: Trump escalates on Iran and sends oil higher, Walmart's beat comes with a soft US sales number, and yields erase Bessent's bounce.

item.title: Yields Ease, Moderna Soars, Fed Minutes Loom
item.description: Treasury buybacks calm the bond market while a Moderna-Merck cancer vaccine and Marvell's Google deal light up equities.

item.title: Long Bond Yields Hit Multi-Decade Highs
item.description: The thirty-year Treasury is at levels not seen since 2007, and stocks still haven't blinked.

item.title: Ceasefire Deadline Looms, Memory Chips Keep Ripping
item.description: Trump threatens Oman as the Iran ceasefire lapses, Micron crosses a thousand bucks, and the VIX hits a low nobody trusts.

item.title: Retail Sales Slump, Yet Records Keep Falling
item.description: Soft retail sales and flat wholesale prices meet Baltic drone tensions, as gold, silver, and stocks all sit near highs at once.

item.title: Soft Inflation Data, Loud AI Concentration Worries
item.description: Wholesale prices came in flat, rate-hike odds faded, and Steve Eisman flagged just how much of the AI trade rides on two companies.

item.title: Cool CPI, Hot Neoclouds, Grim Red Sea News
item.description: July inflation came in exactly as expected, CoreWeave and Nebius ripped on AI demand, and the Red Sea turned deadly again.

item.title: CoreWeave and Super Micro Lift AI Trade Again
item.description: Blowout AI earnings from CoreWeave and Super Micro headline a night dominated by oil, Iran, and tomorrow's inflation print.
